searchText: Is the problem raids? There are solutions to dealing with the individual raids that don't involve shutting off access for everyone, nor implementing ridiculous things like KYC or non-functional things like captchas.. Also, it has been over 24 hours so I think we should turn things back on. Step 1: Add some moderators that don't all live in the same time zone. 😄 I would go a bit further, I'd give essentially everyone with a role here mod rights, surely there won't be abuses and most of us don't have a life so are here anyway what? kyc? added the ability to send messages back can't tell if this is sarcasm? Some servers enable phone number requirements for speaking in a Discord server (high security server setting). I *suspect* perhaps <@755590043632140352> meant "everyone with a role of significance", at least that is how I interpreted it. e.g., all of the core dev teams for example. You can always add a captcha bot, so every new person will have to solve a captcha sent to them via dm's before messaging here. The most common captcha bot is https://captcha.bot/, I made a new server to try it out and it seems easy to configure, there are just 2 problems: a) their default captcha is web based (link to their website, so possible ip fingerprinting/etc) b) the bot requires quite a lot of permissions 🫤 Though I've made discord bots before / have some experience with image manipulation and I can tell it's not a complex task, so you can always have a custom one to avoid 3rd parties. Yeah! <@420951281910284289> no sarcasm meant. I think for simple things like banning a spammer many people here could have mod rights without risking chaos from it Captcha bots are complicated, we're having trouble on prysm's Discord where a fake account appears at the captcha and tries to steal money from our users They also can be bypassed by a sufficiently motivated attacker without too much trouble. And they are surprisingly difficult for actual humans (not the captcha itself, but the process as a whole for someone new to Discord).
